Question: mine is a love marriage , married for 13 years . now from past one year my husband is having an extramarrital affair with a hindu girl . i want to save my marriage and i love my husband a lot. i want him back. i want his love back. i want him to completely forget that girl from the heart and come back to me with full love with all his heart. PLEASE SUGGEST ME A DUA WHICH I CAN RECITE TO GET MY HUSBAND BACK TO ME AND TO LEAVE THAT GIRL FOREVER.. please desperately waiting for your reply and suggestion. khudahafis. thanking u . u r my only hope . Answer ID: 26377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1672/1261/D=1431) Did nikah was solemnized in love marriage according to shariah? If it was not done, then you should correct your nikah according to Islamic ruling. Islamic ruling is that both of you at least have made ijab-o-qubool (proper exchange of nikah words) in the presence of two Muslim witnesses. It is not enough only to sign the paper. If you made your nikah according to shariah, you should see Bahishti Zewar Vol. 9, P. 86-91, there are two practices written chose one of them and follow it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
